raw_segments.text: Practice dwindling. A might-have bean, losing heart. Gambling, debts of honor, reaping the
whirlwind. Used to get good retainers from Dee and T. Fitzgerald. Their wigs to show
the gray matter. Brains on their sleeve like the statue in Glasnivan. Believe he does some
literary work for the Express with Gabriel Conroy. Well-read fellow.
Miles Crawford began on The Independent. Funny the way those newspapermen veer about when
they get wind of a new opening. Weathercocks. Hot and cold in the same breath.
Wouldn't know which to believe. One story good till you hear the next. Go for one another
bald-headed in the papers and then all blows over. Hail fellow well met the next moment.
